edges.reason: _transfer depends on block.timestamp for early sell tax windows and LP burn cadence.
_transfer uses tx.origin to enforce the one-purchase-per-block transfer delay check.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
_transfer invokes swapBack when swap conditions are satisfied.
_transfer triggers autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens on qualifying sells.
swapBack forwards ETH to devWallet through a low-level call while holding contract state.
devWallet receiving ETH can reenter swapBack and the calling transfer flow.
swapBack forwards remaining ETH to marketingWallet through a low-level call.
marketingWallet receiving ETH can reenter swapBack.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens into ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity to seed the pair with tokens and ETH.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap operation.
addLiquidity performs the external router addLiquidityETH operation.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync on the external pair.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync on the external pair.
enableTrading sets tradingActive to true.
enableTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
enableTrading records lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp.
enableTrading records launchedAt from block.number.
_transfer writes _holderLastTransferTimestamp to throttle per-block purchases.
_transfer writes _holderFirstBuyTimestamp for early sell tax tracking.
_transfer reads and writes the _blacklist mapping, blacklisting early snipers.
_transfer sets and checks the swapping guard around swapBack.

updateBuyFees is gated by the onlyOwner modifier derived from msg.sender.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens is gated by the onlyOwner modifier derived from msg.sender.

swapBack reads devWallet to direct the dev ETH share.
swapBack reads marketingWallet to direct the remaining ETH.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForLiquidity when sizing the swap.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForMarketing for ETH distribution.
swapBack reads and resets tokensForDev for ETH distribution.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to decide fee and swap eligibility.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to classify buys and sells.
_transfer reads limitsInEffect to apply limits.
_transfer reads transferDelayEnabled for the anti-bot throttle.
_transfer reads enableEarlySellTax to select the early sell fee schedule.
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount on buys and sells.
_transfer enforces maxWallet on recipient balances.

setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnEnabled.

from parameter feeds the whole _transfer limit, fee and blacklist logic.
to parameter drives the max wallet and buy/sell classification logic.
amount parameter is used in limit checks and fee computation.
fees local accumulates the computed transfer fee before token transfer.
newNum parameter is validated and scaled into maxTransactionAmount.
newAmount parameter is bounded and assigned to swapTokensAtAmount.
percent parameter bounds the manual LP burn amount.
contractBalance local is capped and split inside swapBack.

normalization_plan.reason: newNum is only a parameter of updateMaxTxnAmount/updateMaxWalletAmount and should fold into that function node.
newAmount is only a parameter of updateSwapTokensAtAmount and should fold into that function node.
fees is a temporary local inside _transfer and should be absorbed by the function node.
percent is only a parameter of manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens and should fold into that function node.
contractBalance is a temporary local inside swapBack and should be absorbed by the function node.
from is a parameter of _transfer and should fold into the overriding transfer function node.
to is a parameter of _transfer and should fold into the overriding transfer function node.
amount is a parameter of _transfer and should fold into the overriding transfer function node.
